entries.original_title: Association of systemic lupus erythematosus with C8orf13-BLK and ITGAM-ITGAX
entries.description: Genetic variants at the C8orf13-BLK and ITGAM-ITGAX loci are associated with susceptibility to systemic lupus erythematosus.
entries.citation_sentence: To validate these findings, and to search for additional susceptibility loci, we carried out a meta-analysis of our GWAS results and those from an independent European SLE GWAS comprising 1,165 cases and 2,107 controls (the Hom et al.4 study).
entries.notes: The paper reports a single independent replication cohort testing 33 SNPs, including loci identified in the Hom et al. GWAS and other prior studies; replication results are mixed rather than uniformly supportive. The cited sentence identifies Hom et al. but does not state a publication year.
